comment: The expander check is on the left side only and is by model slug (TreeSeed.cpp:147-152), so the module has to be directly right of Biset-Tree and nothing else will do. The Range, Gate and Polyphony parameters have no widgets on the panel and live only on the right-click menu. The manual points out that the threshold is not a density control, because the Tree's values are not evenly distributed; the code confirms it is a plain comparison against the Tree's first output.
